Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the two-day executive strategy workshop at our San Mateo HQ on Nov 20-21. A couple of security and logistics items came up from Facilities and Legal that we need to confirm before we can publish final visitor badges:

- Sponsor/host on-site details (who will escort Redwood visitors, cell number).
- Full visitor roster with DOB and company affiliation (Valence requires first/last name + company + government ID type).
- Whether Redwood attendees will need background checks or cleared credentials (this is just a two-day visit; please advise).
- Laptop policy — can Redwood staff bring company laptops or should we use Valence loaners?
- Parking passes & reserved spots for execs
- Any NDA / site-safety acknowledgements — Facilities asked for signed acknowledgement prior to badge issuance.

We have an internal site guide attached (valence_site_requirements.pdf). Can you confirm next steps and a point person on your side?

Appreciate it,
Sarah

- Laptops: Our preference is to bring Redwood-managed laptops for demos. If Valence requires loaners, please confirm AV and network provisioning details.

Tessa / Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the ping — we can support this. Summary of what Redwood will need to provide to Valence Facilities by Nov 12 to ensure smooth badge issuance:

1) Completed visitor roster (use the attached visitor_list_template.csv) — include full legal name, company, DOB, and government ID type (passport/driver's license).
2) Signed site-acknowledgement (I attached authorized_visitor_form.pdf) — we will pre-sign on behalf of Redwood and send you a DocuSign link to route to Valence if they need Redwood signature on their form.
3) Device policy statement — if attendees bring Redwood laptops that have disk encryption and MDM enrolled, Valence will allow those. Unmanaged devices must use Valence loaners.
4) Badges & escort: Valence requires a sponsor for each visiting group. The sponsor must meet visitors at lobby and keep them escorted while in non-public areas. Badges will be time-limited for Nov 20-21.
5) Parking: Valence can reserve 3 executive spots — send names & arrival times and I will request parking hang-tags.
6) Background checks: Not required for single-day executive visits unless visitors request access to secure data rooms.

Attachments: authorized_visitor_form.pdf, badge_request_form.pdf (these are Redwood internal forms to collect signatures and host approvals).

Action items for Redwood (internal):
- Marissa: confirm onsite lead mobile + arrival window (Nov 20 morning).
- Rishi: coordinate AV & loaner laptop inventory if any attendee prefers Valence loaner.
- Tessa: send finalized visitor roster to Valence and cc security (monica).

I will prepare the pre-signed site acknowledgement and the DocuSign link today.
